title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.02332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. translated_title: LeanGuard：面向工具使用型智能体的 Lean 验证防护栏
translated_abstract: 使用工具的语言模型智能体经常会执行其领域政策所禁止的操作。我们提出了 LeanGuard，这是一个运行时系统，在每次工具调用到达环境之前，会根据用 Lean4 编写的策略对该调用进行检查。策略将状态谓词与作用于执行历史的限定范围过去时间时序算子相结合，评估采用“故障即关闭”（fail-closed）方式，且决策过程已被证明与 LeanLTL 语义等价。被拒绝的调用可以通过两种方式修正：通过反馈方式，智能体会收到被违反的规则及提示；通过证明引导的修复方式，Lean 元编程在无需模型参与的情况下，搜索一个能保留用户意图的邻近调用，并证明该调用符合策略。在 Tau-Bench 上使用五个 Qwen 模型（0.8B-27B）进行测试，无防护的智能体至少执行了 33 个被 Lean 策略禁止的调用，而 LeanGuard 则一个都没有执行；启用反馈时，任务成功率没有显著变化。在 DTap 上，LeanGuard 降低了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: LeanGuard 是一个基于 Lean4 形式化验证的工具调用运行时防护栏，能在违规操作执行前进行拦截并通过反馈或证明引导修复予以纠正，实验证明它可将违规调用降为零且不显著影响任务成功率。
en_tdlr: LeanGuard is a Lean4-formally-verified runtime guardrail that checks tool calls against formal policies before execution and repairs violations via feedback or proof-guided methods, reducing forbidden calls to zero without significantly hurting task success.
